methodology.drawdown_sampling: weekly exit equity marks; intraweek excursions not measured
methodology.features: 28 complete UTC daily candles ending Sunday 23:59 UTC
methodology.fills: open of Monday 01:00 UTC minute; exit at next Monday 01:00 UTC
methodology.market: legacy Binance USDT perpetual futures candle proxy; funding and spread unavailable
methodology.policy: long/cash target weight in [0,1]; independent pair portfolios; reset at year boundaries for yearly rows
methodology.simultaneous_request_rule: sum of every rolling group of up to the number of scored pairs must fit within one hour under serial execution
